description.value:
An aquatic beast tribe commonly found on and near the Ruby Sea. Their settlements lay beneath the waves, and they believe gods exist in all things, collecting rare items that house powerful Kami.

Standard Racial Traits

  • Ability Score Modifiers: Kojins gain +2 Constitution, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Charisma.
  • Size: Kojins are Medium creatures.
  • Type: Kojins are Humanoid creatures with the reptilian subtype.
  • Base Speed: Kojins have a base speed of 30 feet.
  • Languages: Kojins begin play speaking Common and Kojin. Kojin with high Intelligence scores can choose from: Draconic, Dwarven, Elvaan, Galkan, Giant, Goblin, and Orc.

Defense Racial Traits

  • Hide in Shell: As a full-round action, kojins may retract into their shell, gaining DR/5 Bludgeoning and 20% concealment.
  • Shell: Kojins have a natural armor bonus of +1.

Feat and Skill Racial Traits

  • Natural Swimmers: Kojins have a swim speed of 30 feet with a +8 racial bonus to swim checks, and can hold their breath 4x their Constitution score in rounds.
  • Skilled Traders: Kojins gain a +2 bonus on Diplomacy and Bluff checks.

Offense Racial Traits

  • Eastern Weapon Familiarity: Kojins are proficient with katana and sai.

Senses Racial Traits

  • Low-Light Vision: Kojins have low-light vision.
  • Water Sense: Kojins gain blindsense 30 feet against creatures touching the same body of water.
